cancellation:
If you cancel at least 6 full day(s) before the scheduled departure time, you will receive a full refund.

blurb: This private 2-day highlight sightseeing tour from Hamilton offers a bespoke exploration of some of the North Island’s most iconic destinations, including Tauranga, Rotorua, and Taupō. On this exclusive journey, you'll travel through stunning scenic landscapes, visit the breathtaking McLaren Falls, and explore the vibrant Tauranga harbor and its picturesque beaches. In Rotorua, you'll experience the region’s renowned geothermal wonders, while in Taupō, you'll enjoy the beauty of Lake Taupō, the largest freshwater lake in the Southern Hemisphere, and witness the majestic Huka Falls. Throughout the tour, you'll receive personalized attention, ensuring a comfortable and enriching experience. Accommodation and meals can be tailored to your preferences and will be arranged separately, as they are not included in the tour price.
